annotations.title: Request a conscience check (is this OK?)

description: Request a human judgment on whether a planned action, message or decision is fair, decent and appropriate for the people affected – before your agent acts. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 9 for one human verdict, EUR 29 for a panel of 5. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

affected.description: Who is affected and in what situation.

concerns.description: Optional: what you are unsure about.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

panel.description: True for a panel of 5 instead of one human.

planned_action.description: What the agent plans to do or send.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
